title: Add a walking, standing and jittering scoreboard to the reward viewer
summary: locomotion.reward_viewer accepts ROLE=PATH evaluations and opens with a scoreboard: for each reward, bars show every labelled rollout's mean reward per control beside the first target rollout scored motionless under its own commands, with a verdict naming any rollout or standing still that ties or beats the target role. Rollout panels carry their role.
next: Use the scoreboard to review candidate reward v2 settings with the named reviewer before implementation in locomotion/task.py.
reason: A visualization change to an offline tool changes no measured result, roadmap marker, gate or training reward.
